reviews.author: Peggy G.
reviews.content: I already love all the Madison Reed products and now I love the Color Bar too! What a fabulous experience. The colorists were so attentive to my wishes and needs, made great suggestions, and, of course, did a beautiful job with my roots and blow out. The cost is very reasonable too. I will be back!

reviews.author: Julia K.
reviews.content: Loved the experience! Salon is very cool, and getting my color done was quick and looks beautiful. For those of us who work and don't have too much time to get our hair done, this is a no brainer. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Christine P.
reviews.content: My visit was a wonderful experience. I tried a new color and I left very happy.

reviews.author: Margaret W.
reviews.content: Beyond wonderful. This is a game-changer. I love my color. I love the texture of my hair and the price could not be more reasonable. Best is that they were great in scheduling. For all of these reasons, I will definitely return!!! Thank you Madison Reed!!!

reviews.author: Liz R.
reviews.content: Incredible experience. I felt so pampered. The entire team was talented, professional and fun. I walked away with beautiful hair. Very, very pleased.

question.mainQuestion: What is a Hair Color Bar?

faqs.answer: At Madison Reed Hair Color Bars, our Hair Color Experts color your hair for you for a fraction of the price - and in less time - than a typical salon. We use our premium, ammonia-free hair color and care products made with ingredients you can feel good about to give you your best hair color ever. Our services include All-Over Color, Roots, Highlights, Gloss, and more – and are delivered with love by our pro colorists. You can easily book an appointment online or through our app - and walk-ins are welcome. We have over 90 locations nationwide, and you can be confident knowing you will get the same gorgeous results no matter where you go!

question.mainQuestion: What can I expect at a Hair Color Bar?

faqs.answer:
Here’s what to expect at your first appointment:

Find your perfect match with the help of a pro colorist and meet the team of stylists who will be taking care of you during your appointment.

Sit back and relax as a pro colorist applies our premium hair color, crafted in Italy!

Time for shampoo! Upgrade your rinse with an in-bowl, deep-conditioning treatment for added moisture and shine.

Finish in style with a professional blowout, or self-dry for added convenience. We promise you will leave your appointment feeling confident and unstoppable.

Download our app for a seamless check-in and check-out experience, plus stay updated on your progress throughout your appointment.

question.mainQuestion: What services are offered?

faqs.answer: We offer a variety of hair color services including Roots, All-Over Color, Highlights, Gloss, Blowouts, and more! You can also choose from permanent hair color for 100% gray coverage, or demi-permanent hair color that washes out gradually. We also offer customized memberships that fit your needs, schedule, and budget!

question.mainQuestion: How do I make an appointment?

faqs.answer: You can easily book and manage your appointments online or on our app - and walk-ins are welcome! Many of our 90+ locations nationwide are open 7 days a week so you can get your best hair color ever - wherever and whenever you want it!

We use our premium, ammonia-free hair color and care products made with ingredients you can feel good about to give you your best hair color ever. Our services include All-Over Color, Roots, Highlights, Gloss, and more – and are delivered with love by our pro colorists. You can easily book an appointment online or through our app - and walk-ins are welcome. We have over 90 locations nationwide, and you can be confident knowing you will get the same gorgeous results no matter where you go!

question.mainQuestion: What can I expect at a Hair Color Bar?

faqs.answer:
Here’s what to expect at your first appointment:

Find your perfect match with the help of a pro colorist and meet the team of stylists who will be taking care of you during your appointment.

Sit back and relax as a pro colorist applies our premium hair color, crafted in Italy!

Time for shampoo! Upgrade your rinse with an in-bowl, deep-conditioning treatment for added moisture and shine.

Finish in style with a professional blowout, or self-dry for added convenience. We promise you will leave your appointment feeling confident and unstoppable.

Download our app for a seamless check-in and check-out experience, plus stay updated on your progress throughout your appointment.

question.mainQuestion: What services are offered?

faqs.answer: We offer a variety of hair color services including Roots, All-Over Color, Highlights, Gloss, Blowouts, and more! You can also choose from permanent hair color for 100% gray coverage, or demi-permanent hair color that washes out gradually. We also offer customized memberships that fit your needs, schedule, and budget!
